text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash relished the joy of victory. 
Her parents were overjoyed to see their 
daughter achieve something so truly 
"remarkable."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having reawakened her desire for victory, 
she decided to push through the races as 
planned. As the two of them discussed 
this, however—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Due to physical concerns, the final leg of 
the Classic Triple Crown, the Kikuka-sho, 
was dropped from her goals.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The collapse of the perfect schedule she 
had set at the start. That harsh reality 
brings turmoil to Eishin Flash's heart—
